record.name: Shopify
record.one_liner: Shopify provides APIs, libraries, and tools like the GraphQL Admin API and Storefront API for developers to build apps and custom commerce experiences.

auth.notes: Shopify APIs typically authenticate using OAuth grants or token exchange to acquire access tokens sent in headers such as X-Shopify-Access-Token.

access.notes: Developers can use Shopify CLI and partner resources to get started and create applications.

api_surface.notes: Shopify features GraphQL APIs, webhooks, and official libraries for various languages.

buildability.reasoning: With self-serve CLI tooling, clear documentation, and standard OAuth-based access token flows, building an app or integration is straightforward.

evidence.claim: Shopify API requests use access tokens sent in request headers to authenticate and authorize requests.
Provides GraphQL Admin API, webhooks, and official and community API libraries for Ruby, Node, PHP, Go, and .NET.
